title_zh: 省委常委会（扩大）会议：坚决拥护党中央决定 坚定不移推进全面从严治党
title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting: Firmly Support the CPC Central Committee's Decision and Unwaveringly Advance Full and Strict Governance of the Party
summary_zh: 2026年7月25日，海南省委常委会召开扩大会议，表示坚决拥护党中央决定，并坚定不移推进全面从严治党。
summary_en: On July 25, 2026, the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting, expressing firm support for the CPC Central Committee's decision and unwavering commitment to advancing full and strict governance of the Party.
